from pathlib import Path
src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0, 4)]
    color = grid[points[0][0]][points[0][1]]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points); min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = {(r-min_r, c-min_c) for r, c in points}
    dh = max(r for r, c in shape); dw = max(c for r, c in shape)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for y in range(h-dh):
        for x in range(w-dw):
            if all(grid[y+dy][x+dx] == 0 for dy, dx in shape):
                for dy, dx in shape:
                    out[y+dy][x+dx] = color
    return out
'''
